market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. Oil at $100 and Iran conflict drive risk-off; Dow -300 pts. Yen rally creates FX volatility. US-Canada trade war adds binary risk. AI stocks provide selective upside but broad market under pressure. Expect 5-8% VIX spike. Gold underperforming due to rate-hike narrative despite geopolitics.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI infrastructure capex cycle (Oracle, Caterpillar, memory) supports 12-18 month equity upside. India IPO maturation and China bond market opening ($568B fund) signal EM capital deepening. Copper ATH and copper-driven industrial demand support commodity supercycle. Key risk: if oil stays above $95, inflation derails rate cuts, pressuring multiples.
